versionHistory.note: Updated the Management folder description to clarify that its roles are leadership destinations, most reached after experience.
Initial occupation folder tree - 5 groups and 20 leaf industry folders, imported into the CMS.

meta.importNote: The CMS import consumes the folders array. The top-level meta and scalingRules keys are tooling metadata. Each folder carries extra code and slug fields - stable identifiers used by the CMS. The occupation catalogue uses the same industry slugs. Never rename or reuse a code.

scalingRules: CMS folders are created ONLY by importing this file. Never create, rename or delete folders manually in the CMS UI - change this file first, then re-import.

Split rule - when an industry leaf passes 60 occupations, split it into narrower child leaf folders under the same group. New folder codes take the next unused number. Existing codes are never renamed or reused.
Each occupation belongs to exactly one leaf industry folder. The occupation object's industry slug must match the leaf folder slug.
A new group or leaf folder is a deliberate decision made in this file first (new code), followed by re-importing the file.
Boundary rules - groups are navigation only; the leaf industry folder is the folder that owns the occupation objects.
Tags and search facets are managed inside the occupations application, not in this hierarchy.
